units.source_text: 可是，镜子嘛，似乎难以保证。

en.t: But as for a mirror, that seemed hard to guarantee.

units.source_text: 镜子在这里是消耗品……只半年工夫，镜子里边的水银膜便会浮起来，

en.t: Here, a mirror was a consumable item... in only half a year, the mercury backing inside the mirror would start to lift,

units.source_text: 过了一年，镜面不断让飘流在空中的沙子摩擦，连透明玻璃都会变成毛玻璃……

en.t: and after a year, the mirror surface, constantly rubbed by sand drifting through the air, would turn even clear glass into frosted glass...

units.source_text: 和现在的镜子一样，照出一只眼睛，鼻子便模糊了，

en.t: Just like the mirror now, if it showed one eye, the nose would blur,

units.source_text: 照出鼻子，嘴巴就照不见了。

en.t: and if it showed the nose, the mouth could no longer be seen.

units.source_text: 不，并不是什么耐用不耐用的问题。

en.t: No, it was not really a question of whether it was durable or not.

units.source_text: 和收音机不同，镜子为了成为通道，首先必须以存在“瞧着自己”的他人作为前提。

en.t: Unlike a radio, for a mirror to become a passage, it first had to presuppose the existence of another person who was looking at oneself.

units.source_text: 如果已经到了没有机会再让人瞅一眼的地步，那镜子还有什么用呢？

en.t: If things had already reached the point where there was no longer any chance of being glanced at by anyone, what use would a mirror have?
